title: New law: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2305 Minton Road in West Melbourne, Florida, as the "Ronald W. Reagan Post Office of West Melbourne, Florida". (Public Law 107-7)
summary: H.R. 395 of the 107th Congress became Public Law 107-7 on 2001-04-12.

title: New law: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 620 Jacaranda Street in Lanai City, Hawaii, as the "Goro Hokama Post Office Building". (Public Law 107-6)
summary: H.R. 132 of the 107th Congress became Public Law 107-6 on 2001-04-12.
